desc: Derive the online compressed-interval algorithm for summing maxima over all subarrays of length at most `k`.
Derive the analogous minima structure, including consistent merging of equal values.
Verify the method on both examples and edge cases such as `k = 1`, `k = n`, negative values, and repeated elements.
Implement `minMaxSubarraySum(self, nums: List[int], k: int)` in Python with O(n) time and O(k) auxiliary space.
